title: The Open Drawer
summary: Clerk Vell has found a filing discrepancy so beautiful she cannot close it: three ledgers mis-shelved under wrong-but-poetic manifest descriptions, and their true home is the Top Scale at Keel Town. She has laminated the receipts 'for continuity of feeling', so ride smoothly — the poetry is real, and so is the cargo-integrity meter.

objectives.label: Collect the three mis-shelved ledgers from the exchange
Ride out to the skydocks cargo winch — gently
Deliver the ledgers to the Top Scale, Keel Town

offer.text: Courier Varga, comma, Ash — I have a discrepancy. Asterisk, hushed: it is the most beautiful one on record. Ledger forty-one-D filed under 'harvest, spelt'. It contains four years of absences from the moorage watch. Somebody shelved four years of MISSING PEOPLE under wheat.

And ledger nine — 'rope, sundry' — courier, it is a eulogy. Page after page of eulogies itemised by the knot. I have cross-checked the knots. They are accurate. I am not okay — footnote — I have never been MORE okay.

All three belong at the Top Scale in Keel Town, where mis-shelved things get weighed against what they actually are. I laminated the receipts. For continuity. Of feeling. That's a real form now. I made it a real form.

accept.text: The manifests, aloud, because the courier reads the cargo: one — 'harvest, spelt', see above, underline, wheat, FOUR YEARS. Two — 'rope, sundry, see feelings'. Three — 'salvage, dusk-toned'. I don't know what dusk-toned salvage is either. That's why it goes to the Scale.
'Rope, sundry, see feelings.' Impa, if I say this at the border they're going to weigh my accent.
Say it EXACTLY like that. The Scale respects pronunciation. And mind the lamination, courier — gloss finish, eleven coats. If it scratches, I will file the scratch under grief.
Tamsin on the desk band. Courier, when the clerk starts laminating, the paperwork's already won. Ride like the cargo's awake. In a sense — italic, her italics, not mine — it is.

complete.text: The Top Scale countersigned, asterisk, WITHOUT comment, which from the Top Scale is a parade. Three ledgers re-shelved: absences under absence, eulogies under rope — footnote, apparently correct after all — and the dusk-toned salvage under —
— under a drawer that was already open. Courier. The Scale keeps one drawer open so the desert can file things back. This is in the handbook. Page... dash. It's page dash.
They also sent you the redaction index as counter-gift. Read the entry that's been removed the most. Nine times. It's always removed on a Thursday, asterisk, and I have decided not to wonder why.
Delivered three lies to the one place that weighs them true, and the verdict is a drawer left open on purpose. Filing today under: the Guild has a heart and it's a jammed drawer.
